items.title: MECH-353 blocked-agency (z_block) discriminative diagnostic RETEST -- SD-070 encoder + SD-056 comparator fix
items.note: Retest fixing the comparator-discriminability gap V3-EXQ-642's own FAIL diagnosed (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-642_2026-06-06.md, status=confirmed, Reading A): 642 self-routed substrate_ceiling_comparator_nondiscriminative but the autopsy found it PREMATURE -- P0 trained world_forward on a FROZEN RANDOM encoder with SD-056 OFF, so pred_mag stayed below the 0.05 predicted-effect floor by construction (wf_mse~2e-5 was a low-variance-target fit, not a discriminative comparator); MECH-353 was never actually tested. Fix per autopsy Section 8, all three required changes applied: (1) P0a SD-070 z_world encoder warmup (ree_core/latent/zworld_p0.py via experiments/_lib/zworld_p0_warmup.run_zworld_p0) trains split_encoder.world_encoder + world_precision_logit with anti-collapse VICReg + reconstruction (hazard/resource grounding heads degrade gracefully to a trivial single-class fit on this num_hazards=num_resources=0 env without corrupting the reconstruction/anti-collapse terms this design actually needs); (2) P0b amended to add SD-056 (e2_action_contrastive_enabled=True, weight=0.01, V3-EXQ-613-validated) plus e2_rollout_output_norm_clamp_enabled=True (ratio 2.0, V3-EXQ-689i/617-validated) so world_forward does not collapse the action channel; (3) a NEW P0 readiness gate (experiments._metrics.p0_readiness_gate) re-measures the SAME statistic C0 routes on (blocked_step_mismatch_mean - free_step_mismatch_mean >= 0.10) plus the zworld_encoder_trained precondition on a small pre-registered probe BEFORE committing to the full P1 budget -- a seed failing the gate self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue for that seed (never substrate_ceiling), never counts toward the pass fraction, and P1 is skipped for it; if ALL seeds fail, the whole run self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue. CONSEQUENCE FOR PROGRESS INSTRUMENTATION: verdict-line count (normally seeds x conditions = 6) can be LESS if any seed self-routes at the P0 gate -- expected, not a bug. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (C0/C1/C2/C3 on a TRAINED substrate) not recorded anywhere -- the only prior MECH-353 run (642) carries an untrained-encoder/SD-056-off substrate_hash, incompatible with this config; not recoverable -> ran fresh. Re-derive brake: N/A -- the 642 autopsy explicitly classifies its own result as a measurement/test-design gap, NOT substrate_ceiling (recommended_epistemic_category: none), so the brake count for MECH-353 is 0. Substrate-path overlap gate: two open corrupting-severity substrate_queue.json entries (mode-governance-engagement, SD-082) list a bare ree_core/agent.py path, but both concern no-op-default opt-in consumer paths (mode-governance/affinity-clamp; SD-082 lateral_pfc_analog.compute_bias rule-readout consumer) that this script's config never enables -- not engaged. z_goal is deliberately PINNED per-episode (goal-value held constant, matching 642), never via update_z_goal, so the smoke-test z_goal_stream reads WRITER DEFECT -- this is the intended design (held-constant goal), not a retrofit candidate (retrofitting would confound the SD-024 benefit-attractor pathway, unrelated to what this retest fixes). items.title: MECH-219/SD-019b behavioural evidence: controllability-gated hysteretic suffering, trained substrate (temporal + controllability)
items.note: Behavioural evidence follow-on to V3-EXQ-957 (2026-08-29, confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-957_2026-08-29.json): 957 cleared the MECH-219/SD-019b substrate-readiness precondition (controllability gate wired in live sense(), hysteresis matches theory, SD-021 parity) but is claim-free by design and does not itself constitute MECH-219/SD-019b evidence. This run is that evidence run, named in the design memo (evidence/planning/mech_219_hysteretic_integrator_design.md Section 7) and in 957's routing_note. CLAIM TAGGING (verified against claims.yaml, not inherited from 957's own docstring assumption): claim_ids=['SD-019b','MECH-219'], NOT 'MECH-305'. MECH-219's own claims.yaml what_would_answer explicitly narrows the controllability-gating content OUT to MECH-305 ('Do not treat a controllability-only demonstration as confirming MECH-219'); this run's C1/C3/C5 (controllability gate, non-vacuity, consumer-wiring) are SD-019b's own falsifiable claim and are credited there, while ONLY C2_CONTRAST (asymmetric decay -- z_harm_un releases fast, z_harm_suffering releases slow, from the SAME relief event) is credited to MECH-219 (its own claims.yaml confirming signature 1). MECH-219's other three predictions (non-linear summation, mode-switch separable regression, nonredundancy r2) are NOT tested here and remain open. MECH-305 is NOT tagged: it registers a different, not-yet-built operationalisation with no what_would_answer of its own. C3(b) (MECH-353 z_block_assert anti-correlation), which 957's routing_note asked for, is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: MECH-353's own substrate readiness has never been established (its sole diagnostic, V3-EXQ-642, FAILED substrate_ceiling_comparator_nondiscriminative and was never successfully retested) -- building a cross-check against an unready mechanism would be uninformative. Flagged to governance as a prerequisite gap for a future run, not routed around. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): grepped REE_assembly/evidence/experiments/*.json for z_harm_suffering/harm_suffering_accumulator/HarmSufferingAccumulator -- 2 incidental hits (v3_exq_854 SD-036, v3_exq_876a MECH-025), neither tags MECH-219/SD-019b nor carries this escapability-sweep readout -- nothing recoverable, ran fresh. Step 2.5b re-derive brake: 0 confirmed autopsies tag either claim in claim_ids anywhere in evidence/planning/ -- not braked. Step 2.5c substrate-path overlap: driver's execute closure (harm_suffering_accumulator.py, agent.py sense()-harm/AIC/PAG/MECH-091 wiring, latent/stack.py MECH-099 lateral_head path, cingulate/aic_analog.py, pag/freeze_gate.py, causal_grid_world.py, utils/config.py) checked against every open corrupting-severity substrate_queue.json entry: 'mode-governance-engagement' and 'SD-082' both touch agent.py broadly but neither's call-site family (SalienceCoordinator.tick / lateral_pfc_analog.py::compute_bias) overlaps this driver's actual code path -- no block. DESIGN: on a TRAINED substrate (P0 self-supervised warmup: agent.world_obs_encoder + the MECH-099 lateral_head jointly trained to regress the hazard channel's OWN OUTPUT NORM toward its ground-truth proximity summary; readiness precondition = held-out R2 >= 0.5). Matched-nociception escapability sweep, 5 seeds x 2 conditions (INESCAPABLE: 30-tick bout at dist=1 then escapability->1.0 AND physical teleport to dist=12 for a 150-tick relief window; ESCAPABLE: escapability=1.0 + fixed dist=1 throughout, the 957-precedent non-vacuity comparator). All v1 redirect flags enabled (harm_suffering_redirect_aic/pag/mech091=True) per 957's autopsy requirement -- C5 (AIC, whose tick site is inside sense(), which this driver calls every step) is the gating consumer-wiring check; PAG/MECH-091 flags are enabled in config but their tick sites live in select_action(), which this driver never calls (fixed 'stay' action, no navigation confound, matching 957) -- reported diagnostically, never gating. Escapability sourced 'external' (SD-058 has not cleared its own v3_pending retest as of this run -- checked; memo Section 3/R2 dependency-free fallback). ARITHMETIC REACHABILITY (per dispatch requirement, given 3 prior lettered runs in this corpus shipped structurally unpassable bars): C1/C2/C3/C4/C5 thresholds carry over 957's confirmed empirical margins. C2_CONTRAST was calibrated via 5 real single-seed pilot runs (not the scored run) BEFORE finalising: a first design (absolute ceiling on un's own retention, derived from the naive scalar-EMA prediction) was found UNREACHABLE -- z_harm_un's EMA operates on a 32-dim vector and does not obey the scalar bound (measured retention ~0.75, not the theoretical ~0.33), and 1 of 5 target seeds (41) even showed the WRONG SIGN entirely, traced to agent.world_obs_encoder (untrained, randomly-initialised, sits upstream of the MECH-099 lateral_head that P0 was originally training alone) -- confirmed by direct comparison of a manual lateral_head(raw_obs) call (near/far norm 1.03/0.02) against agent.sense()'s own latent.z_harm for the identical obs_dict (1.83/1.83, no separation at all). Fixed by training world_obs_encoder jointly with lateral_head; re-verified across all 5 target seeds afterward with a consistent ~0.62 gap against the 0.10 pre-registered margin (a ~6x safety factor). Full 5-seed dry-run-equivalent smoke (not the scored run; deleted after inspection) PASSED all six criteria with non_degenerate=true, real cross-seed variance, elapsed_seconds ~39s. SMOKE: --dry-run PASS (single seed, tiny P0/tick counts; R2 0.57, correctly clears the floor even at reduced scale). validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 warnings, 0 non-conforming. items.title: MECH-143: dorsal CA1 value-free map probe (goal-value-change vs goal-location-change discriminative pair)
items.note: EXP-0058 (Duvelle et al. Curr Biol 2019 analog: place fields are geometrically stable and insensitive to reward-value change at a fixed goal location). MECH-143 was untested (evidence: [] in claims.yaml) and depends_on ARC-007/MECH-073/Q-020, all of which are implemented substrate (ARC-007 hippocampal path memory + HippocampalModule/ResidueField, MECH-073 valence-in-map-geometry via SD-014, Q-020 Resolution A splitting value/wanting (z_goal, REEAgent.update_z_goal) from the ResidueField/z_world map HippocampalModule navigates, SD-005). No v3_pending/implementation_phase gate on MECH-143. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout (cosine-distance drift of z_world snapshots at fixed probe positions, pre/post a goal-value-only vs goal-location-only manipulation) is not recorded in any existing manifest -- V3-EXQ-375 (MECH-073) and V3-EXQ-800 (ARC-007) are the closest precedent but neither snapshots z_world at fixed positions before/after a value-vs-location manipulation, and pre-2026-07-12 manifests carry no substrate_hash anyway -> not recoverable, ran fresh. Step 2.5b re-derive brake: 0 substrate_ceiling-category autopsies tag MECH-143 (first run ever) -- not braked. Step 2.5c substrate-path overlap gate: checked substrate_queue.json for open corrupting entries touching ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py, ree_core/latent/stack.py, ree_core/residue/field.py, ree_core/agent.py (update_z_goal/sense) -- none found. DESIGN: 2 arms, matched seeds, CausalGridWorldV2.reset_to() deterministic scripted-eval placement (SD-029/EXQ-433a pattern) for both training episodes and an 8-position probe grid; VALUE_CHANGE holds hazard+resource cells fixed for the whole run and raises env.resource_benefit (0.20->1.00) at the P1A/P1B boundary (raw observations at every probe cell are bit-identical pre/post by construction, so any drift is attributable only to value-differentiated weight drift -- the exact channel MECH-143 makes a prediction about); LOCATION_CHANGE holds resource_benefit constant at 0.20 and instead relocates the resource cell at the same boundary (the positive control: raw observations genuinely differ, proving the probe is sensitive to real structural change). DV-symmetry-invariance (CLAUDE.md /queue-experiment Step 3): VALUE_CHANGE's map_drift is NOT null-by-construction (no symmetry makes it trivially zero -- a nonzero reading is a genuine, not vacuous, finding of weight-level value leakage); LOCATION_CHANGE is deliberately not invariant (positive control). Pre-registered thresholds (C1 VALUE_CHANGE map_drift<0.20, C2 LOCATION_CHANGE map_drift>0.35, C3 paired per-seed ordering LOCATION>VALUE, PASS=C1 AND C2 AND C3, >=2/3 seeds each) are first-of-kind priors with no prior V3 measurement of this probe to calibrate against -- flagged as a real calibration risk, not silently treated as authoritative; a FAIL on C2's absolute threshold with C1/C3 holding would be worth a follow-up recalibration rather than an immediate claim demotion. Non-degeneracy guard: each cell's PRE-snapshot cross-probe-position dispersion must clear 0.02 (check_degeneracy on zworld_probe_dispersion), else that cell's low map_drift reading is representation-collapse, not evidence. SMOKE: --dry-run PASS on ree-cloud-1 (this dispatch box has no torch; ree-v3 CLAUDE.md test-suite routing applied by proxy -- ran in a throwaway detached worktree off HEAD, dry-run manifest correctly relocated to /tmp/ree_dry_run_manifests/ by emit_outcome(dry_run=True), nothing landed in the shared evidence/ tree, worktree + scratch files removed after). All 6 cells (3 seeds x 2 arms) completed without crash; [train] ep N/M, Seed/Condition boundary, and per-cell verdict lines all present; z_goal_stream diagnostic reads writer_calls=646>0, ticks_active=0 (correctly wired, benefit gate simply never opened at dry-run's 3-episode/15-step scale) -- no writer defect. As expected at dry-run scale (9 of 180 real episodes, mostly P0 warmup), PRE-snapshot dispersion was near the degeneracy floor in all 6 cells (map is essentially untrained); this is not informative about the real run and is exactly what P0=60 warmup exists to fix. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 non-conforming, 0 warnings.
